historySyncAuthorization.unknownWarning: The authorization result is unknown. Closing this dialog does not revoke authorization. Check the account’s current authorization status before continuing.
historySyncAuthorization.scope: Authorize text history sync for this session only. Existing history is not added automatically. Audio and citations are not synced. Authorization alone does not start syncing.
